behaviors.description: Replace a wrong authenticator name and option value on an existing remote.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent protected runtime, initially wrong settings, and real private wire-protocol service.
behaviors.expected: The modified name reaches the real service, the final repeated option value arrives unchanged, and its token authorizes the exact protected deployment.

behaviors.description: Enable and disable actual authenticator installation by modifying remote settings.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent protected runtime, available candidate and runtime, and no activation service.
behaviors.expected: Ordered grant/revocation changes whether exact candidate refs deploy; failed outer authentication never downloads protected payloads.

mappings.rationale: A real token exchange distinguishes effective modified settings from their earlier wrong values.

surface_assertions.rationale: Replacing the wrong name reaches the independently implemented service and completes authentication.
The service receives the final updated key value rather than the earlier wrong value.

mappings.rationale: Real installed-ref sets distinguish the persisted grant from its revocation.

surface_assertions.rationale: The final grant installs the exact candidate and dependency runtime.
The final revocation leaves the candidate absent despite an earlier grant.
